title: Honeycomb
description: Classic honeycomb (cinder toffee, hokey pokey) made with caster sugar, golden syrup and bicarbonate of soda. Light, bubbly, golden shards.
steps: Line a 25cm square baking tray, greasing both under and on top of the greaseproof paper.
Pour the sugar and syrup into a large deep saucepan. Stir over gentle heat until sugar dissolves.
Turn up the heat and let the mixture bubble until amber. Turn off the heat immediately.
Add the bicarbonate of soda and stir quickly — it will foam and expand rapidly. Tip into the tray immediately.
Handle gently to preserve the light bubbly texture. Leave to cool for 1–2 hours, then break into pieces.
notes: Serves 6–8. Keeps 2–3 days in a sealed tin. Dip in chocolate for a month-long shelf life.
